donatingPane_desc1: I don't like the intrusive feel of ads in games, and I feel that having players pay for in-game boosts creates a bad impression in the community, as it makes the game feel like a freemium or pay-to-win game.
donatingPane_desc2: However, I like the donation system because nothing forces you to donate — it's purely out of people's goodwill. If you enjoy the game and want more content released faster, I'll gladly spend more time on it if I feel it's worth the investment.
achievementPane_desc: Here you can view your realm rank and all achievements.
account_desc: Once connected, your achievement data will be sent to the server database during auto-save, and you'll be ranked against other players.
jingjiePane_desc: Here are the current player rankings. Simply register an account to participate — everything is automatic.
jingjiePane_nodata: Wait for the next auto-save to see rankings.
helpPane_desc: This guide will take you from the beginning of the game to activating your first Legacy, helping you learn everything you need to know.
help1_desc1: The first thing you can do is start collecting resources. Click on the resource tabs at the top left of the screen to enter the resource interface. You can click on any resource to enter its panel, where you can manually gather resources or build Constructs for automatic production. While all resources can be built, it's recommended to prioritize Lingstone and Lingmu early on.
help2_desc1: To unlock Technique research, you must first build a Lingstone Miner, which requires 10 Lingstone and 5 Lingmu. This is the first step toward automation. The Technique tab is where you build Wudao Platforms to produce Wudao, and where you discover and research new technologies.
help2_desc2: The first technique you can research is 'Sumeru Mustard Seed', which allows you to build Storage upgrades to increase the maximum capacity of each resource. This becomes necessary when building Constructs costs more than 50 of a resource. You can also research 'Qi Gathering Art', opening up a new world of Zhenqi production.
help3_desc1: Each Construct in the game produces different amounts, which can make resource balancing difficult, especially for Zhenqi, Xuantan, and Lingmu, as they are consumed by other Constructs. It's recommended to prioritize which resource Constructs to build first — in most cases, Lingstone — then produce Zhenqi for Qi Gathering Arrays. Don't upgrade everything to Constructs at once, or you'll face Zhenqi shortages (which is bad, because Constructs can't run without Zhenqi). Accumulate Xuantan to build more Constructs, or increase the number of Breathing Arts to handle this.
help4_desc1: To unlock Mystic Realm exploration, you first need to build a Sky Ship. This should be your first major goal. Building a Sky Ship requires many resources, and you may need to use higher-tier Constructs to obtain them in a reasonable time. Second, launching a Sky Ship requires Lingmai, which can be refined in Lingmai Prospecting. These require significant Lingye and Xuantan. Once your Sky Ship is ready, press the launch button to unlock Mystic Realm exploration and new technologies.
settingsPane_desc: You can enable options to change the settings you want.
importExport_desc: Copy this content to a file so you can import it later. You can also create multiple 'saves' by storing separate instances.
hardReset_confirm: Are you sure? This cannot be undone after reset.
aboutPane_desc: This game was made by Freddec as a remake of the original game by Sparticle999. Of course, I have Sparticle999's authorization. I made this game to improve my VueJS skills and learn about incremental games.
about1_desc1: These are all the relevant links outside the game.
about1_desc2: These are links to the original game.
zhenqiPane_desc: Zhenqi is the foundation of cultivation, produced through breathing arts, qi gathering arrays, and progressing to lingmai extraction and Tiandao qi refining.
zhenqiT1_desc: Uses Xuantan as fuel to produce steady Zhenqi supply through breathing techniques.
zhenqiT2_desc: The Qi Gathering Array requires no fuel, slowly absorbing Zhenqi from heaven and earth.
zhenqiT3_desc: Powered by Lingye, extracts the power of Lingmai to produce large amounts of Zhenqi.
zhenqiT4_desc: Harnesses fission power to produce massive amounts of Zhenqi.
zhenqiT5_desc: Uses molten lava as fuel. The extreme temperature allows for large Zhenqi production at once.
zhenqiT6_desc: Through fusion reaction, merges two light atomic nuclei into one heavy nucleus, releasing Zhenqi as vast as the stars.
zhenqiCangPane_desc: You can store up to 100,000 Zhenqi. Unlock Zhenqi Pools to increase this limit.
zhenqiS1_desc: The Celestial Lord said: 'There must be a place to store qi!' And so these pools came into being.
zhenqiS2_desc: Mirror-structured Zhenqi Pools form electric fields around the pool walls to store Zhenqi, with greater capacity.
zhenqiS3_desc: Improved structure makes electric field storage more efficient, forming structural deposits that allow storing more Zhenqi.
zhenqiS4_desc: This pool uses magnetism to draw and maintain electrons from surrounding objects, allowing Zhenqi to be stored outside the pool. When Zhenqi inside is depleted, external reserves can be called upon, accommodating far more Zhenqi than previous tiers.
zhenqiS5_desc: Using nano-techniques, cluster-type pools are improved to near-atomic scale, overlapping electric fields to exponentially increase Zhenqi storage capacity.
zhenqiS6_desc: Using vacuum casting techniques, Zhenqi is sealed within the pool's vacuum, achieving unprecedented Zhenqi storage.
yuanshenPane_desc: Yuanshen is the fourth state of matter, used by Tier 4 Constructs and Grand Sect Arrays as an extreme energy source.
yuanshenT1_desc: The Nascent Soul Projection art blasts Zhenqi into Qingqi, transforming it into Yuanshen substance.
yuanshenT2_desc: This art blasts dense Zhenqi into Taiyi mist, converting it into Yuanshen.
yuanshenT3_desc: Bathed in Yuanshen, what could be impossible?
yuanshenT4_desc: The Apex Array is a massive array built with Xuangang, directing quasar power toward gas giants, instantly converting gas into Yuanshen for collection.
yuanshenS1_desc: The Yuanshen Palace uses specially controlled vessels to contain Yuanshen, keeping it hot and contained.
yuanshenS2_desc: Specially designed Yuanshen Palaces use Hanbing and ventilation techniques, allowing more Yuanshen to condense without damage.
yuanshenS3_desc: Partial vacuum casting techniques isolate the vessel from Yuanshen, allowing further condensation due to vacuum's isolation strength.
tiandaoPane_desc: Tiandao Shards can only be refined from energies purer than mortal techniques, making Yuanshen essential for refining this precious resource.
tiandaoT1_desc: Build automated methods to collect Tiandao Shards without personal effort.
tiandaoT2_desc: Tiandao Shard Refining uses nano-wires immersed in highly radioactive Lingye to capture Tiandao Shards from the star domain. Requires Yuanshen to refine the shards into usable material.
tiandaoT3_desc: An ancient method of obtaining Tiandao Shards: firing high-energy particle beams into barren star domains, then collecting the fragments.
tiandaoT4_desc: No need to destroy star domains — directly build nebulas to create Tiandao Shards!
xuantanPane_desc: Xuantan is a Tier 2 resource used by Breathing Arts to produce Zhenqi for the sect. Xuantan is refined from Lingmu.
xuantanT1_desc: Send all Lingmu here, purify Xuantan traces and refine them.
xuantanT2_desc: Burns Lingmu at extreme temperatures, yielding purer Xuantan than the refining method.
xuantanT3_desc: Melts Lingmu with earthfire, cooling to obtain relatively pure Xuantan. Residuals can be recycled.
xuantanT4_desc: This Yuanshen-driven furnace reaches extreme temperatures, refining Lingmu into nearly perfect pure Xuantan.
xuantanT5_desc: Who would have thought broken charcoal tips could produce so much Xuantan?
lingyePane_desc: Lingye is formed from spiritual qi condensing within earth veins, used to refine Tier 2 Spirit Artifacts.
lingyeT1_desc: Set up a minor Spirit-Drawing Array to gather Lingye from earth veins.
lingyeT2_desc: Lingye Springs far surpass Spirit-Drawing Arrays, able to well forth abundant Lingye, yet require Zhenqi as the catalyst.
lingyeT3_desc: Lingye Refining Fields are large open areas, usually located beneath Lingmai, where abundant Lingye can be found underground.
lingyeT4_desc: The Lingye Furnace is a massive structure floating above the Ling Sea, extracting Lingye from the sea floor.
lingyeT5_desc: Far superior to its predecessors, this array reverses the fossil cycle — instead of burning, it creates Lingye from the air.
lingstonePane_desc: Lingstone is the basic currency of cultivation, used for various constructions and refining.
lingstoneT1_desc: Forge a Spirit Pickaxe for your miner.
lingstoneT2_desc: Lingstone Veins can mine Lingstone on a large scale.
lingstoneT3_desc: The Spirit Gathering Array extracts Lingstone at astonishing speed.
lingstoneT4_desc: The Lingstone Furnace warps space-time, obtaining Lingstone at speeds beyond physical limits.
lingstoneT5_desc: Mines Lingstone from parallel worlds rich in Lingstone.
baoshiPane_desc: Baoshi is one of the main resources, used for advanced Constructs and powerful tools. More important in the late game.
baoshiT1_desc: Forge an improved Spirit Pickaxe to mine Baoshi.
baoshiT2_desc: Baoshi Veins can mine Baoshi on a large scale. Slower than Lingstone Veins due to drill hardness requirements.
baoshiT3_desc: The Gem Condensation Art is one of the strongest drilling techniques in the spirit realm, surpassing previous Baoshi extraction speeds.
baoshiT4_desc: Carbyne drilling is one of the strongest drilling techniques in the spirit realm, surpassing previous Baoshi extraction speeds.
baoshiT5_desc: This special container condenses spiritual energy into Baoshi, faster than any drilling method.
lingmuPane_desc: Lingmu is one of the main resources, more commonly used for tools and buildings in the early game.
lingmuT1_desc: Forge a Spirit Axe for the Lingmu Lumberjack.
lingmuT2_desc: The Lingmu Forest uses Qi-driven tools to fell Lingmu, far more efficient than manual labor.
lingmuT3_desc: The Ten-Thousand Wood Art accelerates Lingmu growth. Though it drains Lingmai, the yield is remarkable.
lingmuT4_desc: Lingmu Acceleration compresses waste materials into Lingmu, turning refuse into treasure.
lingmuT5_desc: The Ten-Thousand Wood Array gathers spiritual energy from heaven and earth to grow Lingmu endlessly.
yunjinPane_desc: Yunjin is essential for Tier 3 automated mining systems. These will be very helpful for building your first Legacy. Though a higher-tier resource, it's mainly obtained by heating Lingsha in the mortal realm.
yunjinT1_desc: This method instantly transforms Lingsha into Yunjin, but at limited scale. Requires off-world resources to build.
yunjinT2_desc: This method nearly melts the coastline to obtain Yunjin on a large scale.
yunjinT3_desc: This large-scale destructive method has been renamed and now hovers above the coastline — or rather, what remains of it.
yunjinT4_desc: This massive array encircles the earth, focusing on the wasteland, tearing Lingsha from the ground and transforming it into Yunjin under extreme heat.
yunjinT5_desc: This array harnesses the power of distant stars, heating Lingsha into Yunjin at record speed.
leilingPane_desc: Leiling can be used for Zhenqi production, as fission releases large amounts of Zhenqi. Thus, it plays an important role in many advanced Constructs and propulsion techniques. Unfortunately, Leiling is difficult to obtain and requires significant resources for radiation shielding.
leilingT1_desc: Crush Leiling ore to transport it from deep wells.
leilingT2_desc: This tower teleports underground rock to the surface, making Leiling easier to mine.
leilingT3_desc: Leiling Summoning improves Leiling quality, allowing more Leiling to be utilized.
leilingT4_desc: Recycles used Leiling, giving it a second purpose. Greatly increases available Leiling per second.
leilingT5_desc: This massive array, as large as a star, fuses Leiling from common elements.
huoyanPane_desc: Huoyan is difficult to harness, existing only in volcanoes, and is one of the hardest resources to obtain.
huoyanT1_desc: You can use a modified crucible to scoop Huoyan for storage.
huoyanT2_desc: Automatically and quickly extracts Huoyan from volcanoes.
huoyanT3_desc: Rather than going out to find Huoyan, it's more convenient to create it yourself using heat and pressure.
huoyanT4_desc: A furnace of agony, pouring Huoyan from ore.
huoyanT5_desc: Condenses the spiritual energy from the Suixing Realm's core into lava.
yueshiPane_desc: Yueshi is found in the Yuejing Realm, a rare resource unseen in the mortal world. Stronger than Lingstone, but harder to obtain.
yueshiT1_desc: Hire local workers to collect Yueshi for you.
yueshiT2_desc: These drilling devices are practically floating!
yueshiT3_desc: This mine tears the Yuejing Realm's surface, visible from the earth.
yueshiT4_desc: This large construct digs deep into the earth, searching for abundant Yueshi near the core. Lingstone originally came from deep underground.
yueshiT5_desc: Still wondering why there are so many moons in the sky?
miasmaPane_desc: Miasma is abundant on the Taibai Realm, and can power the sect more efficiently than solid fuel.
miasmaT1_desc: Inhale Miasma while purifying the celestial body!
miasmaT3_desc: These spirit beasts have been modified to continuously produce Miasma.
miasmaT4_desc: Collects spiritual energy from the Zhenxing Realm's satellite's ocean floor Lingmai.
miasmaT5_desc: A spirit beast spanning star domains.
xuangangPane_desc: Xuangang is primarily found on the Yinghuo Realm, used to build sturdy Constructs and Miasma arrays.
xuangangT1_desc: Hire prospectors to find Xuangang exposed by sandstorms on the Yinghuo Realm's surface.
xuangangT2_desc: These Yueshi drilling devices are extremely powerful, mining Xuangang from the Yinghuo Realm's crust.
xuangangT3_desc: This modified construct has five drills on its front. Greatly increases resource yield per second.
xuangangT4_desc: This mighty drill is said to be wielded by ancient giants themselves.
xuangangT5_desc: You strike me down, but I shall not fall. I am Xuangang.
jinshaPane_desc: Jinsha exists within star domains, used to build Legacies and complex Constructs.
jinshaT1_desc: Miasma-powered mechanical beasts search for Jinsha veins in the star domain.
jinshaT2_desc: Drills into star domains to find Jinsha. More efficient than simple mechanical beasts.
jinshaT3_desc: That's no moon! That's a space station! This method slices open the star domain, exposing Jinsha within.
jinshaT4_desc: Accelerates time through quantum techniques to produce more Jinsha.
jinshaT5_desc: Refining has advanced to the point where air can be transformed into Jinsha!
yinshaPane_desc: Yinsha is another metal commonly found in star domains.
yinshaT1_desc: Scout Sky Ships search for Yinsha fragments embedded in meteorites within the star domain.
yinshaT2_desc: Slices open star domains to find Yinsha veins in the core.
yinshaT3_desc: This large space drilling construct, named after the giant cannon from a war a thousand years ago, is specifically designed for mining Yinsha from star domains.
yinshaT4_desc: This powerful array orbits the Haiwang Realm, breaking down the star domain's surface to reveal Yinsha within.
yinshaT5_desc: Silver bullets used for hunting demon beasts are made from Yinsha compressed a thousand times over. Extracting them will benefit your production.
qingqiPane_desc: Qingqi is extremely common on gas giants like the Suixing Realm and Zhenxing Realm.
qingqiT1_desc: This collector orbits the Suixing Realm, searching for Qingqi to store and bring back.
qingqiT2_desc: The Gathering Array magnetically attracts Qingqi, increasing collection per second.
qingqiT3_desc: These are manufactured in the mortal realm, capable of converting water into Qingqi with sustained Zhenqi supply.
qingqiT4_desc: For some reason, it just works.
qingqiT5_desc: 'Stealing' is too strong a word. I prefer to call it 'borrowing without return' — as we harvest from the outskirts of stars.
taiyiPane_desc: Taiyi is the second most common element on gas giants like the Suixing Realm and Zhenxing Realm.
taiyiT1_desc: Taiyi Condensation scouts Taiyi-rich areas on the Zhenxing Realm, then slowly mines them.
taiyiT2_desc: This massive container holds large amounts of Taiyi, transported from the Zhenxing Realm to the earth through the void.
taiyiT3_desc: The refiner densely compresses Taiyi into a small space for easy transport back to earth.
taiyiT4_desc: Flying into a gas giant's atmosphere with large barrels — that's our best plan!
taiyiT5_desc: A controlled miniature sun uses nuclear fusion to produce massive amounts of Taiyi.
hanbingPane_desc: While Hanbing can be collected in the mortal realm, it's far more rewarding to visit the Mingxing Realm for a full harvest. Primarily used for super-cooling technology required by Tier 4 Constructs.
hanbingT1_desc: Hanbing Condensation is the simplest way to mine frozen water — cheapest, but also slowest.
hanbingT2_desc: The Hanbing Condensation Array is more efficient than basic condensation, yielding more Hanbing per second. But requires Zhenqi.
hanbingT3_desc: With advanced techniques, you can now convert mortal water into high-quality Hanbing, previously only available from the Mingxing Realm.
hanbingT4_desc: This construct is the coolest guy in the spirit realm.
hanbingT5_desc: Extracting heat from materials at extreme speed. You're not sure how to handle it safely, but you did it anyway.
wudaoPane_desc: Wudao is used to research new techniques, advancing your cultivation progress.
wudaoT1_desc: Build a small Scripture Pavilion to start producing Wudao. Each produces 0.1 Wudao/sec.
wudaoT2_desc: Build more efficient Dao Seeking Platforms to explore the realm of Dao at a faster pace. Each produces 1 Wudao/sec.
wudaoT3_desc: Build higher-tier Wudao Platforms to further explore the realm of Dao. Each produces 10 Wudao/sec.
wudaoT4_desc: Create an Observatory, gazing at the stars to gain knowledge of the Great Dao.
wudaoT5_desc: Beyond the mortal dust, without atmospheric obstruction, comprehending the Dao of Heaven and Earth is far more efficient.
gongfaPane_desc: Research new techniques to unlock more mechanics and advance your cultivation progress.
techCangku_desc: Allows you to build storage upgrades, increasing the maximum capacity of each resource.
techZhenqi1_desc: You will be able to burn Xuantan in a furnace to produce Zhenqi.
techLingye_desc: Lingye is used to power more advanced Constructs and can also produce more Zhenqi than basic methods. Unlocking the Path of Lingye allows you to extract Lingye from underground.
techZhenqi2_desc: Qi Gathering Arrays produce Zhenqi without fuel, but slower than other Zhenqi production methods.
techJinglian_desc: Refined Constructs produce more resources than simple methods, but require sustained Zhenqi supply.
techSuimie_desc: Allows you to dismantle built Constructs. Useful when you have more efficient resource acquisition methods or insufficient Zhenqi to maintain Constructs.
techLingmai1_desc: Unlocks Lingmai exploration, allowing Sky Ship launches and opening an entirely new field of techniques.
techLingmai2_desc: Lingmai Development is a more efficient method of Lingmai refining.
techLingmai3_desc: The Lingmai Grand Array is an array refined with Miasma that accelerates Lingmai production.
techWudao2_desc: Researching this technique will greatly increase Wudao production.
techWudao3_desc: Researching this technique will unlock Tier 3 Wudao production, far surpassing the previous tier.
techWudao4_desc: Researching this technique will unlock Tier 4 Wudao production, with ten times the output of the previous tier.
techZhenqiCang1_desc: The Zhenqi Pool Art increases the amount of Zhenqi you can store at once.
techZhenqiCang2_desc: Zhenqi Pool Advancement increases the amount of Zhenqi you can store at once.
techZhenqiCang3_desc: Zhenqi Pool Mid Tier increases the amount of Zhenqi you can store at once.
techZhenqiCang4_desc: Zhenqi Pool High Tier increases the amount of Zhenqi you can store at once.
techYuanshen1_desc: Allows you to convert Zhenqi and Qingqi into Yuanshen.
techYuanshen2_desc: This research unlocks Tier 2 Yuanshen production — Deity Transformation Art.
techYuanshenCang1_desc: Yuanshen Palace increases the amount of Yuanshen you can store at once.
techYuanshenCang2_desc: Advanced Yuanshen Palaces store Yuanshen more efficiently but are larger and require more resources to build.
techWuhua1_desc: This technique not only lets you create resources you already have, but also allows you to produce new elements only obtainable through conversion, such as Tiandao Shards.
techTiandao0_desc: Tiandao Shards are one of the rarest resources in the star domain, artificially refined. All Tiandao Shards that once existed in the star domain have been depleted, and now they can only be refined using Zhenqi in Constructs.
techTiandao1_desc: Research automated methods for collecting Tiandao Shards without personal effort.
techTiandao2_desc: Research more efficient methods than manual refining for obtaining Tiandao Shards.
techDafazhen1_desc: The Sect Grand Array deploys arrays around the sun, producing large amounts of Zhenqi.
techDafazhen2_desc: The Sect Grand Array uses array rings around the sun, while the Completed Array fully envelops the sun, granting you enough Zhenqi to traverse star domains.
techChongqun1_desc: Imagine a locust plague, but worse. These spirit insects double one resource's production for every ten! At the cost of rare Xuantan-based materials, we gladly offer the blueprints for this exquisite technique.
upgradeJinglian_desc: Makes your Constructs produce more resources. This upgrade doubles the output per unit of Zhenqi.
upgradeZhenqi1_desc: After upgrading the Breathing Art, each one produces 4 Zhenqi/sec instead of 2.
upgradeZhenqi2_desc: After upgrading the Qi Gathering Array, each one produces 3 Zhenqi/sec instead of 1.5.
boostChanwu_desc: Production Boost increases resource income by 1%/sec per level.
boostWudao_desc: Wudao Boost increases Wudao production by 2% per level.
boostZhenqi_desc: Zhenqi Boost reduces Zhenqi consumption of all Constructs by 1%/sec per level.
boostZhenqiCang_desc: Zhenqi Storage Boost increases Zhenqi Pool capacity by 1% per level.
mijingRukouPane_desc: Building a Sky Ship will allow exploration of Mystic Realms and resource collection in the Spirit Realm.
mijingRukou1_desc: To launch a Sky Ship into the Mystic Realm, you must first complete its construction.
mijingRukou2_desc: Launching the Sky Ship into the Mystic Realm will unlock Spirit Realm mining, exploration, and other star domains. This requires Spirit Wings for navigation assistance.
lingmaiPane_desc: Lingmai is refined through Lingmai Prospecting, used for Sky Ship launches and travel to other Mystic Realms and star domains.
lingmaiT2_desc: Lingmai Development refines Lingmai faster and more efficiently than Prospecting.
lingmaiT3_desc: The Lingmai Grand Array accelerates Lingmai refining using greenhouse gases like Miasma.
yuejing_desc: The Yuejing Realm is our largest satellite, orbiting the earth every 27 days. It contains abundant Yueshi, originating from when it separated from the earth billions of years ago. Yueshi is stronger than Lingstone and is used to build more advanced Constructs.
chenxing_desc: The Chenxing Realm is a lifeless rocky celestial body with almost no value. Surface exploration is not worthwhile as there are no valuable materials.
taibai_desc: The Taibai Realm is the hottest celestial body in the Spirit Realm and the closest to the earth. It's rich in greenhouse gases, causing extreme heat. You can extract Miasma from the Taibai Realm to establish new Zhenqi production methods.
yinghuo_desc: The Yinghuo Realm is the second closest celestial body to the earth, covered in red iron oxide. You can find Xuangang on the surface, but the crust is even richer. Xuangang will allow building Miasma arrays and Yunjin production.
xingchen_desc: The Xingchen Realm is a vast star domain with nearly 2 million meteorites. There you can more easily collect metals rare in the mortal world, such as Jinsha and Yinsha.
mijingStation_desc: The Tiandao Mystic Realm is a massive mysterious structure. What lies within is not exactly known, but carvings on ancient artifacts depict something similar. It's said that inside, you'll learn about a nearly supernatural Celestial Lord who rules over the star domain. He will supposedly teach you much on your journey traversing the stars.
suixing_desc: Building an orbital station in the Suixing Realm's atmosphere to collect Qingqi would be ideal!
zhenxing_desc: We found treasure! At least metaphorically. The Zhenxing Realm is the second largest celestial body in the Spirit Realm, after the Suixing Realm. It's one of the few with rings and has the lowest density. You can find Taiyi here.
tianwang_desc: This celestial body rotates differently, with wind speeds up to 300 mph (483 km/h). Its composition is similar to other gas giants, primarily consisting of Qingqi and Taiyi. Not worth exploring for the same resources as the Zhenxing and Suixing Realms.
haiwang_desc: The Haiwang Realm has the most bizarre celestial phenomena in the Spirit Realm. Massive storms and winds fiercer than anywhere else. There's nothing there but Miasma, Qingqi, and Taiyi.
mingxing_desc: Hanbing, Hanbing! Manufacturing large quantities of Hanbing in the mortal realm is extremely expensive — collecting from the Mingxing Realm is far more economical!
zaohuaRukou0_desc: Vast emptiness separates lonely rocks, drifting in 300-year orbits around the sun. Yet there is something extremely important waiting to be discovered here.
zaohuaRukou1_desc: Welcome to our home. Our kind is dedicated to cultivation progress and communication with other races. If you're willing to trade with us, we'll provide technique blueprints rarely seen in the star domain.
mijingStationPane_desc: As you enter the rotating pyramid complex in space, you feel your Sky Ship drawn by a subtle force toward the entrance on the lowest side. Stepping off onto artificial gravity, you walk toward the grand hall ahead. Four massive murals hang on the walls, depicting magnificent structures in every corner, with inscriptions below. At the far end of the hall is a massive door, tightly shut with no sign of opening. You sense a higher being watching as you walk through the hall. Note: You must activate Legacies after building them to receive their effects.
mijingBaoshi0_desc: The first painting depicts a massive shimmering building. The inscription reads: 'Though my wealth is unparalleled, I still cherish adding precious resources to my collection. At the cost of your Baoshi, Yinsha, and Jinsha, I will teach you secrets about the earth beneath your feet, enabling you to discover a rare resource and a dangerous element never seen before.'
mijingLingmu0_desc: A pulsating image depicts a massive pyramid crackling with electrical energy. What does the Celestial Lord want this time? 'Having depleted the spiritual power of many stars, I desire a monument to the spiritual power I seized from the star domain. In return, I will grant you a method of spiritual power production that no one has ever been able to harness.'
mijingYunjin0_desc: A green-tinted image shows the interior of some array system. 'With my technique advantage in the star domain, I want a monument to the advanced array systems I control. As a reward, I will teach you array construct techniques so you can build more advanced resource extraction Constructs.'
mijingTiandao0_desc: A fiery red portrait depicts a set of futuristic Constructs. 'You've accomplished much, but now you must build a legacy structure. As the next monument, I will grant you a Construct that exists only in legends. Tiandao Shard Constructs use built-in Zhenqi to convert Yuanshen into raw power for resource extraction.'
mijingBaoshi1_desc: The Celestial Lord is pleased with the new wealth, granting you the method to create Spirit Wings, which orbit the earth and can discover new resources. Activating this Legacy will teach you about Leiling — how to obtain and harness it. Understanding this rare element hidden deep underground will unlock Nuclear Zhenqi, a new method of Zhenqi production.
mijingLingmu1_desc: Now possessing the Spiritual Power Pyramid, the Celestial Lord grants you techniques for partial Zhenqi production. Activating this Legacy will allow you to harness Huoyan power, a new method of Zhenqi production.
mijingYunjin1_desc: The Celestial Lord is proud of the new monument, teaching you array construction and advanced resource extraction. Activating this Legacy will allow you to build Tier 3 Constructs — a more efficient method of resource extraction.
mijingTiandao1_desc: The Celestial Lord gazes upon the newly built Legacy, granting you a new wave of Construct power surpassing all before. Activating this Legacy enables you to build Tier 4 resource extraction Constructs, more powerful and efficient than any previous Constructs.
mijingChuansong_desc: In the center of the room, you see a charred antenna dish lying on the ground. The inscription beside it reads 'My original communication array between my first two star domains.' A booming voice sounds again from the speakers in the corner: 'This is one of my most cherished mementos, reminding me of the first message I sent between star domains. If you can repair it for me, I will help you conquer the stars.' Rebuilding the Communication Legacy will allow you to communicate with races in other star domains and determine if intelligent life exists.
mijingFeizhou_desc: On the second floor, you find a chaotic scene of broken Constructs and scattered parts. You can reassemble what appears to be a Sky Ship engine nearby. The Celestial Lord's booming voice comes from the room's speakers: 'Greetings, friend. As you can see, this floor is largely in disrepair. If you can fix it, you'll be well rewarded. Your first task is to repair the Legacy on the right. It was once a Sky Ship engine, but I'm not sure where the parts are. You may need extra research to rebuild it, but I believe you can manage.' Rebuilding the Sky Ship Legacy will grant you advanced techniques, teaching you how to fly beyond your small star domain.
mijingFangun_desc: In the corner of the floor, you see a large, faintly glowing container leaning against the wall. Pressing the red button next to it plays an announcement: 'This is the first Revenant Jar I used on my maiden interstellar voyage. To repair it and recall my memories, I will teach you the art of Revenant refining, helping you fly beyond this world.' Rebuilding the Revenant Legacy will grant you Revenant refining and storage abilities.
mijingChuansongMen_desc: A massive frame resembling obsidian stands in the room, mounted on the far wall. The inscription reads: 'This is the passage to the third and topmost floor of the Tiandao Mystic Realm. Activating it requires substantial resources, but once complete, it will grant you access to the Hall of the Celestial Gate — the only way to leave this small star domain and explore beyond.' Activating the Portal will allow you to pass through to the third floor of the Tiandao Mystic Realm, separated from the main pyramid.
tiandiFazhenPane_desc: The final floor, though smallest in area, appears to be a treasure room, displaying majestic control consoles and a large table.
mijingXingmen_desc: After rebuilding the Heaven-Earth Array Immortal Gate, you will be able to explore beyond your star domain.
techYuanshen0_desc: Yuanshen is a state of extreme spiritual power, usable as vast energy storage and enabling higher-tier Constructs and conversions.
techWuhua0_desc: Five Elements Conversion is a technique mortals only dare dream of. Here, it has become reality. You can convert Zhenqi and Yuanshen into conventional resources, or with massive investment, into rare resources — those you cannot find and can only obtain through refining.
techDafazhen0_desc: This technique was unheard of before, now made possible by the ancestors of the Forge of Creation. The Sect Grand Array can provide massive Zhenqi for millions of years, but at what cost? Note: Array Segment consumption is based on how many you own, so it resets when depleted or decreases when partially consumed.
wuhuaPane_desc: Five Elements Conversion is a technique mortals only dare dream of. Here, it has become reality. You can convert Zhenqi and Yuanshen into conventional resources, or with massive investment, into rare resources — those you cannot find and can only obtain through refining.
dafazhenPane_desc: This technique was unheard of before, now made possible by the ancestors of the Forge of Creation. The Sect Grand Array can provide massive Zhenqi for millions of years, but at what cost? Note: Array Segment consumption is based on how many you own, so it resets when depleted or decreases when partially consumed.
lingzhenDuan_desc: These massive arrays cannot be built all at once. You must start with small segments, forged around the sun.
dafazhenT1_desc: The Ring is an array belt orbiting the sun, producing 5,000 Zhenqi/sec. A total of 50,000 Lingmai is needed to deploy Array Segments.
dafazhenT2_desc: The Cluster is an array formation orbiting the sun, producing 25,000 Zhenqi/sec once built. However, it requires 250,000 Lingmai to deploy Array Segments.
dafazhenT3_desc: The Completed Array is a grand array that fully envelops the sun. It will provide enough Zhenqi for star domain travel, eventually leaving this star domain. It produces 1,000,000 Zhenqi/sec.
chongqun_desc: Imagine a locust plague, but worse. These spirit insects double your production for every ten! They can replicate the form of other Constructs and take on their roles. You can select one resource to boost and change it at any time.
lingyinPane_desc: Here you can learn about other star domains to explore. Note: The first star, Alpha Centauri, is 4.3 light-years away. One Spirit Resonance Array cannot reach it.
lingyinT1_desc: The theoretical problems of star domain travel are about to be solved. Use this upgrade to resolve them. This is a one-time upgrade that increases your exploration range by 5 light-years.
lingyinT2_desc: The Celestial Lord grants you the technique of using Spirit Resonance Arrays to discover star domains beyond. Each array adds 1 light-year of exploration range.
feizhouPane_desc: Here you can build Sky Ships to travel to the stars.
feizhou_desc: The Sky Ship can travel to stars in the star domain but cannot land on celestial bodies within the domain.
huti_desc: This array protects against solar radiation, keeping those aboard safe from the void's cold.
dunfa_desc: These engines combine Revenant and matter in controlled reactions, generating thrust to propel you toward the stars.
lingyi_desc: Spirit Wings allow Sky Ships to easily enter and exit atmospheres without worrying about air resistance.
fangunPane_desc: The fuel for your star domain travel is refined here. Unfortunately, each Mystic Realm can only process 100,000 Revenant due to its extreme instability.
fangunT1_desc: This powerful array can convert high-energy Yuanshen into the most efficient fuel we can imagine.
diziT1_desc: Outer Disciples are the smallest and fastest, costing the least. Though seemingly insignificant, their numbers can be deadly in battle.
diziT2_desc: Larger than Outer Disciples, Inner Disciples are medium combat units. Stronger attack, but noticeably slower.
diziT3_desc: Core Disciples are medium-sized with decent speed among their other attributes. Slightly weaker defense, but attack and speed make up for it — a good choice for filling disciple ranks.
diziT4_desc: Elders are an expensive investment, but reward with balanced power, defense, and speed. They are high-end disciples, both in stats and cost.
diziT5_desc: The Sect Master is a heavily defense-oriented disciple, yet can still deal devastating blows with powerful attacks. The main drawback is slow speed, which hampers group mobility.
chiyanMijingPane_desc: The Chiyan Sect is a fierce sect with strong hatred for those in power — especially the Biluo Sect. They fight relentlessly, attacking enemies with full force. Their upgrades mainly favor a more active playstyle.
biluoMijingPane_desc: The Biluo Sect is the ruling power in the star domain, most dedicated to maintaining the status quo. Opposed to change, they exercise authoritarian rule and mainly provide upgrades related to Sect Grand Arrays and Legacies.
zixiaoMijingPane_desc: The Zixiao Sect is a cultivation-loving sect, proud of all technique progress and always looking to the future. They fight for truth and welcome anyone who shares their beliefs.
jinguangMijingPane_desc: This private faction is growing in the star domain, profit-driven and allied with those who support their goals. Their upgrades focus on passive gains, with extensive automation features.
xuanmingMijingPane_desc: The Xuanming Sect is an expansion-focused sect, aiming to conquer star domains. They often play both sides in conflicts, hoping to profit from the chaos. They provide travel improvements, including Sky Ship construction and star domain travel.
tiandaoLawPane_desc1: We've arrived, seemingly at the end of the journey, but you don't realize... this is only the beginning. Looking up at the stars, you ponder how to use your newly acquired wealth and the sects in the Spirit Realm.
tiandaoLawPane_desc2: Suddenly, the Celestial Lord speaks to you: 'You have cultivated for a long time, and I sense your life is approaching its end after years of sect management. Yet, you haven't achieved what I expected.'
tiandaoLawPane_desc3: 'Though I'm disappointed that you haven't reached the greatness I expected, out of your loyalty and devotion to me, I am prepared to give you another chance at life.'
tiandaoLawPane_desc4: 'You will have many opportunities to satisfy me, for when you feel the time is right and need to make a sacrifice, I will grant you the power of Ascension. Your sect will be stronger after each Ascension, and as long as you remain loyal to me, I will guide you in conquering the star domain.'
tiandaoLawPane_desc5: 'You will start anew, a new life, but at the cost of your soul. I will reward your next life with the Dao you've learned in this world and one of the most precious materials in this realm — Tiandao Law.'
tiandaoLaw_desc: Here you can see how much Tiandao Law you've obtained and what you'll gain upon Ascension.
dmWonders_desc: You earn Tiandao Law for completing each floor of the Tiandao Mystic Realm. You may have already achieved all of these before your first Ascension. Each floor completion grants 4 Tiandao Law, but the final floor only grants 2 (only one Legacy).
dmSpheres_desc: Building a Completed Array in your local star domain grants 15 Tiandao Law. Each one built in other star domains grants 5 Tiandao Law.
dmResearches_desc: Every 25 levels of repeatable Technique research efficiency grants 2 Tiandao Law.
dmRank_desc: Reaching each achievement realm grants 2 Tiandao Law. Since the first few achievement realms are easy, this will be the main source of Tiandao Law early in each Ascension.
dmSwarms_desc: One of the more complex systems, Tiandao Law from Spirit Swarm is calculated using triangular numbers. You gain 1 Tiandao Law when passing each triangular number of Spirit Swarm. For example: 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21...
rebirth_desc: Entering a new life is a momentous decision not to be taken lightly. Once confirmed, you can start anew, preserving the knowledge and experience of your past life, reborn and transcending your former self. You will retain all unused Tiandao Law and your upgrades. Taking this step is not just a leap for this lifetime, but for every Ascension. Once activated, you will no longer feel so weak. Note: Even your second Ascension requires a Completed Array. Note: You will retain all upgrades purchased in your past life.
rebirth_confirm: Are you sure? This cannot be undone after reset and save.
chiyanChuanchengPane_desc: The Chiyan Sect is a fierce sect with strong hatred for those in power — especially the Biluo Sect. They fight relentlessly, attacking enemies with full force. Their upgrades mainly favor a more active playstyle.
upgradeLingqu_desc: Increases all gain buttons from 1 to 20 per click. Increases relationship by 3.
upgradeCangku1_desc: Each Ascension starts with all resource storage at 6,400 max. (No effect if already above 6,400.) Increases relationship by 6.
upgradeCangku2_desc: All Storage no longer costs 100% of the main resource, but 75%. Increases relationship by 14.
techZhenqiCang6_desc: Unlocks Vacuum Zhenqi Pool. Increases relationship by 15.
upgradeCangku3_desc: Opens rifts in multi-dimensional space, allowing you to store resources in other dimensions up to 10x beyond default capacity, with production reduced by 95% after overflow. Increases relationship by 26.
biluoChuanchengPane_desc: The Biluo Sect is the ruling power in the star domain, most dedicated to maintaining the status quo. Opposed to change, they exercise authoritarian rule and mainly provide upgrades related to Sect Grand Arrays and Legacies.
techYuanshen3_desc: Unlocks Deity Transformation Array. Increases relationship by 4.
upgradeMijing1_desc: All Legacy activation costs in the Blessed Realm reduced by 15%. Increases relationship by 10.
upgradeMijing2_desc: All Legacy activation costs in the Immortal Citadel Core and Heaven-Earth Array reduced by 20%. Increases relationship by 15.
upgradeMijing3_desc: Blessed Realm Legacies are auto-built each Ascension. Still need activation. Increases relationship by 11.
techYuanshen4_desc: Unlocks Deity Transformation Apex Array. Increases relationship by 17.
techYuanshenCang3_desc: Unlocks partial vacuum casting Yuanshen Palace. Increases relationship by 12.
autoWuhua_desc: Once activated on a Five Elements Conversion resource, it will automatically convert at the set interval. Increases relationship by 17.
zixiaoChuanchengPane_desc: The Zixiao Sect is a cultivation-loving sect, proud of all technique progress and always looking to the future. They fight for truth and welcome anyone who shares their beliefs.
upgradeWudao1_desc: Each Ascension starts with 20 Tier 1 Wudao Platforms. Increases relationship by 3.
upgradeWudao2_desc: Tier 2 and above Wudao Platform costs reduced by 20%. Increases relationship by 12.
techWudao5_desc: Unlocks Wudao Platform Apex. Increases relationship by 14.
upgradeZhenqiBoost_desc: Raises Zhenqi Boost research cap from 25% to 50%. Increases relationship by 25.
jinguangChuanchengPane_desc: This private faction is growing in the star domain, profit-driven and allied with those who support their goals. Their upgrades focus on passive gains, with extensive automation features.
upgradeTier1_desc: All Tier 1 resource Constructs (in resource tabs) cost reduced by 10%. Increases relationship by 4.
techZhenqiCang5_desc: Unlocks the fifth tier Zhenqi Pool for all your Zhenqi storage needs. Increases relationship by 17.
multiBuy_desc: Unlocks the power of batch building and dismantling! Increases relationship by 20.
boostLingyun_desc: For each resource at storage capacity, all other resources gain 5% production bonus. Increases relationship by 18.
techTier5_desc: Grants research access to Tier 5 resource Constructs. These unlock after activating the Tier 4 Tiandao Legacy. Increases relationship by 20.
xuanmingChuanchengPane_desc: The Xuanming Sect is an expansion-focused sect, aiming to conquer star domains. They often play both sides in conflicts, hoping to profit from the chaos. They provide travel improvements, including Sky Ship construction and star domain travel.
upgradeLingmai1_desc: Lingmai Prospecting (Tier 1) Lingmai output increased by 100%. Increases relationship by 7.
upgradeDizi_desc: Sky Ship component costs reduced by 35%. Increases relationship by 28.
techTiandao3_desc: Unlocks Tiandao Shard Condensation building. Increases relationship by 29.
techTiandao4_desc: Unlocks Tiandao Shard Furnace building. Increases relationship by 36.
tiandaoChuanchengPane_desc: This sect is shrouded in mystery. Though not well understood, a powerful force overlooks the entire star domain, seemingly above the other five sects and their 'petty' disputes. Upgrades from your Celestial Lord are not type-constrained and vary greatly.
boostTiandaoLaw_desc: Each point of unused Tiandao Law adds 1% bonus to all resources (including Wudao). Increases relationship by 20.
techChongqun0_desc: Imagine a locust plague, but worse. These spirit insects double your production for every ten! They can replicate the form of other Constructs and take on their roles. You can select one resource to boost and change it at any time. Note: Appears in the Forge of Creation after unlocking. Increases relationship by 17.
upgradeZongmen_desc: All sect relationships increased by 20. Increases relationship by 20.
toastAchievement_text: You have achieved a new milestone.
toastAutoSave_text: Your save data has been stored locally in your browser.
toastSpySuccess_text: You successfully spied on the Mystic Realm's defenses.
toastSpyFailed_text: All your Outer Disciples were lost.
toastInvadeSuccess_text: You successfully invaded the Mystic Realm, gaining production bonuses.
toastInvadeFailed_text: The enemy was too powerful. All your disciples perished.
toastAbsorbSuccess_text: You peacefully absorbed the Mystic Realm, gaining production bonuses.
spy_desc: Here you can send disciples to gather intelligence on enemy fleets. At the first level, you can see the number of digits in enemy stats. The second level reveals the first digit of all three stats, and each subsequent level reveals the next digit.
invade_desc: Here you can activate disciples and attempt to invade the sect's Mystic Realm. Your relationship with them affects their readiness. The Mystic Realm's stats account for this. Invasion negatively impacts your relationship with that sect — successful invasion reduces relationship by 10. However, due to their arrogance, failed attempts are deemed unworthy of note, so relationship remains unchanged.
absorb_desc: Absorption is the easiest way to conquer a Mystic Realm. Unfortunately, you must maintain a good relationship with the controlling sect — relationship above 60 is required to absorb. You lose 5 relationship points upon absorption, half that of invasion.
